repos_data.description: Kuvasz (pronounce as [ˈkuvɒs]) is an open-source uptime and SSL monitoring service, with multiple notification channels, status pages, IAC support via YAML, Prometheus integration, a complete REST API and many more!

LastPing — an AI agent can create and instrument its own monitor over MCP, then run unattended. Also watches the cron jobs and CI/CD pipelines underneath it. Alerts when a run goes silent, stalls, fails or loops. Free for individuals. → lastping.dev
HostTracker MCP server: connect an AI assistant to your uptime monitoring. Client setup, tool catalogue, registry manifest.
MCP server for UptyBots — connect AI assistants to your uptime monitors
